title: HSA and Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine: independence of Singapore's approval process
asked: Mr Yip Hon Weng asked whether the Health Sciences Authority has received a recent submission for Moderna's mRNA influenza vaccine, and to what extent Singapore's safety and efficacy validation process remains independent of US and European standards.
response: Dr Koh Poh Koon said HSA has not received any regulatory submission for Moderna's mRNA seasonal influenza vaccine. He said HSA always exercises its regulatory authority independently, while noting that regulatory bodies reference each other. He described HSA's review process: an expert panel, comprehensive data including Phase 3 randomised controlled trials, post-market follow-up of at least six months, GMP compliance, batch consistency and stability data.
